pages.text: $(l)Uranium Ore$() is rare and found deep in the Overworld, from Y 16 down to the bottom of the world, more often the deeper you go. Its yellow-green clumps glow faintly in the dark. You need at least an $(l)iron pickaxe$(); Fortune gives more Raw Uranium, Silk Touch the ore block itself.

$(li)$(item)Raw Uranium$()$(br)$(li)$(item)Uranium Ingot$()$(br)$(li)$(item)Fuel Rod$()$(br)$(li)$(l:nuclear/radiation)Depleted Fuel Rod$(/l)$(br)$(li)Smelt $(l)Raw Uranium$() (or the ore) in a furnace or blast furnace into an $(l)Uranium Ingot$().$(br)$(li)A $(l)Fuel Rod$() is 3 Uranium Ingots in an iron casing.
pages.title: From ore to fuel

pages.text: A Fuel Rod lasts $(l)40 minutes$() in a $(l:nuclear/fission_reactor)Fission Reactor$(/l) at 100% power; its durability bar shows the fuel left. At higher power it burns proportionally faster. A spent rod becomes a $(l)Depleted Fuel Rod$() in the reactor's waste slots.
pages.title: Burning fuel

pages.text: Depleted Fuel Rods are $(l)nuclear waste$(): carried, stored or dropped they make the area $(l:nuclear/radiation)radioactive$(/l). Take them out of the reactor (by hand or with a hopper under a Reactor Port) and treat them in a $(l:nuclear/waste_reprocessor)Waste Reprocessor$(/l). If the reactor's waste slots fill up, it starts leaking radiation.
Uranium uses the common c: tags, so ore processors and machines from other mods handle it too.
